description: This file defines the GatewayHealthMonitor class in Swift, responsible for performing periodic health checks within a gateway application. It manages configuration, scheduling, and timeout handling for health check operations using Swift concurrency features.

classes.name: GatewayHealthMonitor
classes.description: A final class managing periodic health checks for a gateway, including configuration, scheduling, and failure handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes GatewayHealthMonitor with optional configuration and sleep function.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the health check loop, periodically invoking the check and handling failures.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing health check task.
